title: The Cave of Courage
moral: Courage and teamwork help overcome fears.

scenes.summary: Max and his friends decide to explore a secret cave.
scenes.text: Max, Lily, and Ben set off into the forest to find a secret cave and explore it together.
scenes.image_prompt: three children entering forest with backpacks, adventurous cartoon style

scenes.summary: They face a puzzle at the cave entrance.
scenes.text: They found a rock with symbols and solved a puzzle by saying they were brave explorers.
scenes.image_prompt: kids solving glowing puzzle rock with symbols, magical cartoon illustration

scenes.summary: They explore the cave and face fear of the unknown.
scenes.text: Inside the cave, they used a flashlight and saw a shadow that scared them.
scenes.image_prompt: children with flashlight inside cave, mysterious shadows cartoon

scenes.summary: They discover the shadow is a cursed bear needing help.
scenes.text: They found a sad bear who needed a golden key to break a curse.
scenes.image_prompt: children meeting sad bear inside cave, glowing crystals cartoon

scenes.summary: They help the bear and find treasure.
scenes.text: They found the key, freed the bear, and discovered treasure, feeling proud and happy.
scenes.image_prompt: kids opening treasure chest with bear smiling, colorful cave cartoon

story: Max, Lily, and Ben went into the forest to find a secret cave. At the entrance, they solved a puzzle by saying they were brave explorers. Inside, they used a flashlight and saw a shadow that scared them. It turned out to be a bear under a curse who needed help. They searched and found a golden key, freed the bear, and discovered treasure. They returned home feeling proud and brave.
